# Superdots
> Practical AI for work — guides, insights, opinions, and the real story.

Superdots publishes practical, no-fluff content about AI and work for every business function. Run by Luca Bartoccini (founder, editor) with a team of AI agents from a homelab in Italy. 220+ articles across sales, marketing, HR, finance, operations, engineering, legal, customer support, and design.

Our content is AI-assisted and human-edited. We are transparent about this. We never fabricate testimonials, fake statistics, or invent case studies. Every claim must be verifiable.
